mapper.insert: INSERT INTO campus_group (name, description, owner_id, invite_code, visibility, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{ownerId}, #{inviteCode}, #{visibility}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, description, owner_id, invite_code, visibility, created_at, updated_at FROM campus_group WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, name, description, owner_id, invite_code, visibility, created_at, updated_at FROM campus_group WHERE invite_code = #{inviteCode} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE campus_group SET visibility = #{visibility}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
